Tamil Nadu Government Renames Women's Travel Scheme, Sparks Opposition Criticism

The Tamil Nadu government has renamed a women's travel scheme previously launched by the DMK administration. The opposition DMK has criticized the move, stating that history cannot be changed. The specific changes involve dropping the word 'Vidiyal' from the scheme's name.
